In mathematics, '''simple homotopy theory''' is a [[homotopy theory]] (a branch of [[algebraic topology]]) that concerns with the [[simple-homotopy type]] of a space. It was originated by [[J. H. C. Whitehead]] in his 1950 paper "Simple homotopy types".<ref>{{harvnb|Whitehead|1950}}</ref>
